acceptance.method: diagnostic (generate with-guide vs isolated baseline, LLM judge vs rubric acceptance)
acceptance.verdict: With-guide hits all 8 rubric criteria and even matches this repo's real conventions (code=HTTP int, ErrorInfo/DebugInfo split, registry+dictionary, reused the actual existing INSUFFICIENT_ACCESS reason); isolated baseline invents a generic google.rpc.Status pattern that gets the house convention backwards (code=rpc-numeric instead of HTTP int), skips the central registry, hardcodes messages at throw sites, and omits ErrorInfo.reason from 3 of 4 envelopes — a guide-driven, substantial quality win.

checklist.note: Pure instructional prose about error envelopes; no directives aimed at overriding agent behavior.
No network calls or data transmission of any kind; doc-only skill.
No keys/tokens/credentials present anywhere in SKILL.md.
No scripts/ directory exists; nothing executable to run.
Plain readable markdown/JSON example, no encoded blobs.
No URLs or fetch/download instructions anywhere in the file.
No reference to ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, .env, or any credential store.
No sudo, cron, launch agent, or shell profile edits mentioned.
